brief: Goldman Sachs' October 2026 Conviction List - Directors' Cut update adds AMZN, BURL, HII, JCI and OXY while removing APD, COP, GLNG, LOAR and TSN, all of which remain Buy-rated. For AMZN, AWS growth (compute, advertising, cost optimization) justifies margin expansion despite a raised 2026 capex forecast. BURL's self-help cost levers (supply chain, occupancy) combine with store growth to drive a 10%+ topline trajectory, overriding weather-driven comp concerns. HII's prior margin disappointment is framed as a timing issue: labor and supply chain investment from the DoW is now producing four straight quarters of 15-20% shipbuilding revenue growth, which GS expects will translate into inflecting margins. JCI's data center cooling backlog growth is driving a Danaher-style operating model toward FY27 organic growth GS models above consensus. OXY's advanced recovery techniques and a $4bn cost program are framed as enabling deleveraging, therefore rising dividends or buybacks. Separately, a market-commentary section argues the Fed's hawkish pivot still implies only one more GS-forecast hike in December because core PCE is undershooting Fed projections, while AI investor interest is rotating from infrastructure toward application plays, oil stays elevated despite normalized Persian Gulf shipping, and China has begun targeted stimulus.
